title: ATLAS GeoJSON Export
description: INTERCHANGE FORMAT, NOT STORAGE. Records live in the MDM envelope; this is the RFC 7946 view emitted for map tools that speak GeoJSON and nothing else. The mapping is lossless in both directions: Feature.geometry comes from geo.point or geo.shapes[], and Feature.properties carries the rest of the envelope verbatim. Legacy ATLAS keys are still accepted on read so existing files keep parsing.

metadata.description: Kept at this name rather than `meta` because the existing ATLAS writer already emits it here.

id.description: GeoJSON feature id. Mirror the record's `id` here so map click handlers can resolve back to MDM.

geometry.description: From geo.point (as a Point) or one entry of geo.shapes[]. A record with several shapes exports as several features sharing one properties.id.

feature_properties.description: The MDM envelope minus `geo`, so the feature round-trips back into a record without loss. Legacy ATLAS keys below are deprecated but still read.

type.description: MDM record type - NOT the GeoJSON type, which is always 'Feature'.

address.description: Flattened from geo.address, since geo itself is dissolved into the Feature.

shape_role.description: Which geo.shapes[].role this feature's geometry came from. Absent means it came from geo.point.

name.description: LEGACY ATLAS. Read as `label`; writers should emit `label`.

_atlasType.description: LEGACY ATLAS. Dropped on import - it only restated geometry.type.
